The honest case for buying PUZZLE now is weak, and I'd recommend skipping it.

The strongest points: it's alive at 30.5 minutes, not an airdrop-dump factory coin, and the last 15 minutes show real activity (363 buyers, 288.9 SOL bought, net inflow of 30.7 SOL, and a 50% return). The 30-minute return of +142% and $119K market cap suggest momentum has attracted outside buyers, and the pool depth of 134 SOL is reasonable for a $20 ticket.

But the rest of the brief argues against it. The curve shows 85% of buying came from bundles, the top 3 holders control 63%, and the top 5 early buyers took 59% of early flow, which looks operator-driven rather than organic demand. Sellers (133) are a large share of participants and sold 258 SOL against 289 bought, so the recent net inflow is thin. The coin is already 21.6% off its 30-minute high, and sell-to-buy in the first two minutes was 0.63, meaning early exit pressure was high. Against a base rate of about -20% per trade for random post-graduation buys at this age, and with 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs, there's no clear edge that demand persists for the next 30-60 minutes.

Recommendation: skip.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss path: insider distribution by the bundled wallets. Post-graduation, top5_buyer_share is 0.592 and sell_to_buy_ratio is 0.6322, so sellers are already eating into buying pressure. The 30-minute return of +141.7% has retraced 21.6% from its high, and last_15_min net_flow is only +30.7 SOL against 258 SOL sold. A launch bot is present and the completer took just 6.5%, so the rally looks engineered rather than organic. With a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost and a 134 SOL pool, a 20% drawdown from here would wipe out a $20 ticket. Skip.
